reading: This is a hero section for a type-foundry landing page: a borderless nav, a tight 3-line display headline with a green accent word, grey subcopy, a stats row with a top rule, an outline 'Download trial' button, a giant per-letter stylised word, a tilted yellow 'NEW v2.0' badge, and a tilted pink marquee bar — all styling and copy taken verbatim from the typed notes.

actions.instruction: Add a nav bar with no border/box: bold 'GLYPH/LAB' on the left in white (#ffffff), and 'Fonts · Tools · Night school' on the right in grey (#9a9aa6) — each word
Add a giant Helvetica Heavy headline, tightly set (line-height 0.92), broken into exactly 3 lines that must stay whole and never rewrap: 'Nine' / 'weights,' / '
Add grey (#9a9aa6) body copy: 'A neon display family drawn for signs that hum. Every weight ships with its own glow profile.'
Add a stats row 460px wide with ONLY a 1px #2b2b33 rule along its top edge (no borders elsewhere, no fill). Below the rule, place three items on one line spaced
Add a pill-shaped outline button labeled 'Download trial' with a bright green (#39ff9c) outline and text.
Add the single word 'AgR&QeS7?' in giant Helvetica off-white letters on one line, each letter its own span with its own font-size/weight, all sharing one bottom
Add a vivid yellow circular badge, tilted 16° clockwise, about 130px across, with centred black (#09090c) text 'NEW v2.0' wrapped onto 3 lines at 14px.
Add a vivid pink bar, tilted 2° anticlockwise, spanning the width, containing bold 16px black (#09090c) marquee-style text: 'GLOW · HUM · BUZZ · FLICKER · GLOW
